VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report claims all 88 tests pass and describes reasonable technical work (switching to integer cents, adding regression tests, manual concurrent load testing), there is no independent evidence to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 88 tests pass," which demands objective verification through CI logs, test output, or other artifacts with higher admissibility than self-attestation. Without attached diffs, CI logs, or test results, there is no way to independently confirm the fix was actually implemented or that the test suite genuinely passes.
